lines.text: The readers are dull of hearing and need milk, because solid food is for the mature who distinguish good from evil.
The writer urges leaving the elementary teachings and going on to maturity, if God permits.
Those who have been enlightened and then fall away cannot be restored to repentance, because they crucify the Son of God again.
Land that drinks in the rain and bears a useful crop receives God's blessing, but land with thorns will be flooded.
God will not forget the readers' work, and they should imitate those who inherit the promises through faith and patience.
